question: Can a department change the qualifications it asks of empanelled consultants?
gold_answer: Yes for the profile of personnel, through change orders (RFP 24.19); not the years of experience (05-03-2024)

gold_grs_detail.title: Regarding Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra - Educational Qualification of Consultants

raw.answer: No newer GR found in this corpus (covers 2018 to 2024) that amends, replaces, stays, extends, or clarifies the 201803201319308011 GR on consultant qualifications. The 202403051249430211 circular clarifies that departments can change the 'Profile of Personnel' via RFP clauses but cannot change the 'Years of Experience' mentioned in the GR, which pertains to the broader empanelment framework but does not amend the specific educational qualification table in the 2018 GR.
